operation.body:
### Goal

Implement **FR-002**: users can browse submitted feedback in an inbox list.

### Acceptance criteria

- Add an index (or equivalent inbox) route and view listing all feedback items.
- Order newest first with a deterministic tie-break when `created_at` matches (e.g. secondary sort by id).
- Each row shows title, description, category, and creation time with labelled, keyboard-accessible markup and escaped user text.
- Link from the post-submit flow and/or home page so a demo user can reach the inbox after submission without manual URL entry.
- Add automated tests covering ordering (including tied timestamps if feasible) and visible fields at an appropriate boundary.
- Run `bin/rails test`, `bash tests/test-adapter.sh`, and `./scripts/check-workflow-leak.sh`; report results in the PR validation section.
- Do not implement category change UI (FR-003), filtering (FR-004), restart persistence acceptance (FR-005), invalid-request edge cases beyond what exists (FR-006), sample dataset or final docs pass (FR-008), or edits to `docs/security-review.md`.

### Constraints

Parent project authorization is `self-correcting-review auto-merge`. Inherit eligible auto-merge when preconditions are met. Branch name must include `issue-<n>`. Keep the change reviewable in one PR.

### Out of scope

Category assignment flows, filters, process-restart evidence, authentication, production deployment, CI workflow redesign, and unrelated documentation churn.

### Relevant context

FR-001 landed on `main` (goal #12, PR #13): `Feedback` model with title, description, category defaulting to `other`, new/create/show flows. See `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` FR-002 and `.ai/docs/architecture-direction.md`.
